      "requirement": "Source selection SHALL resolve once to immutable commit/tree and byte digests under an approved root. Intake SHALL reject traversal/expansion hazards and unsupported external source dependencies. Credentials and credential-bearing Git metadata SHALL be removed before untrusted execution.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF12",
        "WF13"
      ],
      "task": "4.2",
      "sources": [
        "E22",
        "R16"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-024-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a verified exact source revision",
          "when": "intake completes",
          "then": "the build receives bounded credential-free bytes with provenance"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-024-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "source contains an escaping symlink or unsupported external submodule",
          "when": "intake validates it",
          "then": "capture fails explicitly rather than fetching arbitrary bytes or silently omitting files"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-025",
      "title": "First-class local and Git development",
      "requirement": "The developer project SHALL offer documented install/dev/test/build commands, exact SDK/toolchain requirements, synthetic fixtures and ordinary source history. The complete custom-source journey SHALL be possible using a supported external IDE and normal Git without Asym-hosted inference or IDE.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF12",
        "WF18"
      ],
      "task": "4.3",
      "sources": [
        "R01"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-025-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a developer has the supported toolchain",
          "when": "they clone and follow documented commands",
          "then": "they can run, test and submit a compatible package"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-025-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "no Asym browser IDE or AI credential exists",
          "when": "they complete development",
          "then": "no mandatory feature blocks the Git delivery path"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-026",
      "title": "Independent isolated clean builds",
      "requirement": "Qualification SHALL build exact captured source under an admitted frozen toolchain/dependency profile in isolated nonproduction execution. No production data, permanent provider token or serving-head authority is exposed. Mutable workspace output and customer-controlled CI SHALL not constitute independent approval.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF13"
      ],
      "task": "4.4",
      "sources": [
        "R16",
        "E22"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-026-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "source passes its own tests",
          "when": "the platform builds and checks the exact capture",
          "then": "independent evidence binds the resulting artifact"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-026-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "source modifies its tests to pass or runs a hostile install script",
          "when": "the trusted pipeline qualifies it",
          "then": "independent checks and isolation remain effective"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-027",
      "title": "Immutable admission and explicit first-party trust",
      "requirement": "An admitted package SHALL bind artifact/source digests, compatibility, settings/renderer manifest, dependencies/licenses, maintainer and qualified evidence. Admission SHALL be a distinct platform-owned decision. Signature, language types or test success alone SHALL not establish arbitrary-code safety.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF13",
        "WF14"
      ],
      "task": "4.5",
      "sources": [
        "R14",
        "R16"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-027-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "complete evidence passes under a known policy",
          "when": "the admission owner approves",
          "then": "an immutable verdict identifies exactly the admitted bytes"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-027-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "repository administrators forge a passing status",
          "when": "a Site attempts activation",
          "then": "the missing independent admission blocks it"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-028",
      "title": "Separate server and editor builds",
      "requirement": "Public presentation SHALL preserve server-rendered essential content and the existing public view model; client editor configuration SHALL contain no server-only imports or authority. Editor and public builds SHALL prove compatible rendering/field bindings without forcing all public content into client rendering.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF12",
        "WF13"
      ],
      "task": "2.3",
      "sources": [
        "E12",
        "R16"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-028-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "an admitted component has public and editor entrypoints",
          "when": "both render the same contract fixture",
          "then": "content meaning and binding behavior agree"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-028-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "client config imports a database or server secret module",
          "when": "qualification examines the graph",
          "then": "the package fails admission"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-029",
      "title": "Fixed complete authorized preview",
      "requirement": "An exact candidate SHALL seal complete deliberately selected inputs and reauthorize every preview request. It SHALL be private/no-store/noindex, side-effect-dark, candidate-local and complete-or-unavailable. Its identifier SHALL not grant access.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF08",
        "WF17"
      ],
      "task": "5.1",
      "sources": [
        "R17"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-029-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "an authorized user reviews a sealed candidate",
          "when": "they navigate its Pages and links",
          "then": "all output comes from the exact candidate closure"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-029-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a target is missing or access expires",
          "when": "the request is made",
          "then": "it fails privately rather than falling through to Live or causing real side effects"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-030",
      "title": "Newer work does not rewrite reviewed work",
      "requirement": "Later drafts or source commits SHALL not change an existing selected candidate. The UI SHALL identify excluded newer work and offer explicit successor preparation. Current safety/authority/cohort and required compatibility changes SHALL still be enforced before use and activation.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF08",
        "WF14",
        "WF17"
      ],
      "task": "5.1",
      "sources": [
        "R07",
        "R17"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-030-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a candidate pins revision A",
          "when": "an editor later saves revision B",
          "then": "review remains A with B visibly excluded"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-030-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "candidate A loses required eligibility",
          "when": "a publisher attempts release",
          "then": "the safety/authority failure blocks A notwithstanding its earlier approval"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-031",
      "title": "Package availability distinct from activation",
      "requirement": "New executable presentation SHALL become available through the controlled managed runtime build/registry before dependent activation. Availability SHALL not make it public by itself. Required older renderers/assets SHALL remain available for active and retained generations.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF13",
        "WF14"
      ],
      "task": "5.2",
      "sources": [
        "R15",
        "R16"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-031-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a new admitted package is deployed into the registry",
          "when": "no design activation occurs",
          "then": "current Sites retain their existing presentation"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-031-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a runtime lacks the selected required version",
          "when": "activation is requested",
          "then": "readiness fails without substituting a different renderer"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-032",
      "title": "Single ordinary public publication owner",
      "requirement": "Content/composition release SHALL use D1 with exact compatible selections, current authority/safety, expected-head compare-and-swap and a durable receipt. Normal content edits SHALL not require a new Core code build. Tenant editorial policies SHALL not be replaced by a new blanket manual approval.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF08"
      ],
      "task": "5.3",
      "sources": [
        "R05",
        "R15"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-032-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "an authorized compatible content edit",
          "when": "the existing editorial policy permits publication",
          "then": "D1 activates one coherent successor without rebuilding application code"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-032-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "two publishers race on the same expected head",
          "when": "both attempt commit",
          "then": "only a valid winning transition commits; no mixed generation appears"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-033",
      "title": "Complete-cohort design activation",
      "requirement": "Site presentation activation SHALL use D10 over every current public locale and qualified dispositions for enabled nonpublic locales. It SHALL reprove the exact cohort and expected heads and atomically change all required heads or none, without changing unrelated content or operational meaning.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF07",
        "WF14"
      ],
      "task": "5.3",
      "sources": [
        "R15"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-033-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "all locale candidates are ready and current",
          "when": "the design is activated",
          "then": "the exact complete cohort advances together"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-033-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a locale is enabled or a head changes during review",
          "when": "activation runs",
          "then": "the stale cohort cannot partially activate"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-034",
      "title": "Restore creates a new valid successor",
      "requirement": "Editorial restore SHALL create a private draft successor; design restore SHALL use the existing new-successor process over current compatible content and current safety. Neither SHALL rewind history, reset content to a development snapshot or automatically reinstate an unsafe artifact.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF10",
        "WF14",
        "WF15"
      ],
      "task": "5.3",
      "sources": [
        "R07",
        "R15"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-034-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a prior compatible design is requested",
          "when": "restore proof passes",
          "then": "a new current-content successor is activated with retained history"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-034-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "the previous design is now safety-ineligible",
          "when": "restore is attempted",
          "then": "it is refused without weakening the adverse rule"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-035",
      "title": "Exact-revision scheduled operations",
      "requirement": "D13 appointments SHALL retain exact reviewed semantic intent, organization-owned authorization, civil/zone/offset/UTC data and generation-fenced lifecycle. Later autosaves SHALL remain excluded. Routine initiator offboarding SHALL not alone cancel organization intent; explicit invalidation SHALL prevent execution.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF09"
      ],
      "task": "5.4",
      "sources": [
        "R08"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-035-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "an appointment selects revision A",
          "when": "revision B is saved and the initiator later leaves routinely",
          "then": "only authorized A may execute under current organization rules"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-035-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "an appointment is canceled or its safety authority invalidated",
          "when": "an old delayed event arrives",
          "then": "it has no favorable public effect"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-036",
      "title": "One durable execution and scheduling substrate",
      "requirement": "Background work SHALL reuse shared product dispatch, claims and registered purpose-scoped workers. Identifier-only events SHALL not contain source/content/secrets. D13 SHALL retain the six-day handoff horizon and shared overdue recovery; Payload Jobs or per-Tenant schedulers SHALL not become publication authorities.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF09",
        "WF13",
        "WF14"
      ],
      "task": "5.4",
      "sources": [
        "R08",
        "R10",
        "E23"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-036-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "committed work awaits executor delivery",
          "when": "the shared executor retries after its dedupe window",
          "then": "product receipt/claim still prevents duplicate effects"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-036-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a job requests full content or a secret in its envelope",
          "when": "validation runs",
          "then": "dispatch is rejected before external transmission"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-037",
      "title": "Versioned convergence and adverse priority",
      "requirement": "Derived cache/search/delivery state SHALL follow committed public generation receipts and current adverse rules. A delayed older event SHALL not restore withdrawn information. Convergence failure SHALL not undo an unrelated valid source write or imply source publication failed.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF04",
        "WF08",
        "WF14"
      ],
      "task": "5.5",
      "sources": [
        "R05",
        "R10"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-037-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "D1 commits but a derived projection lags",
          "when": "staff inspect status",
          "then": "Published and convergence lag are distinct"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-037-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "an old favorable update follows a current withdrawal",
          "when": "a projection processes it",
          "then": "the adverse filter wins and forbidden content is not re-exposed"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-038",
      "title": "Receipt-based retry and cancellation",
      "requirement": "Retryable effects SHALL have durable semantic identity and truthful accepted/running/succeeded/failed/canceled/unknown states where appropriate. Client or provider cancellation SHALL not be represented as undoing a committed effect. Unknown outcomes SHALL be reconciled before successor requests.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF09",
        "WF13",
        "WF14",
        "WF16"
      ],
      "task": "6.1",
      "sources": [
        "R10",
        "E25"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-038-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a worker response is lost after a durable effect",
          "when": "recovery runs",
          "then": "the original receipt is resolved without duplication"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-038-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a user cancels after activation already committed",
          "when": "the UI receives the authoritative outcome",
          "then": "it reports the completed effect and offers its actual owner recovery, not false cancellation"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-039",
      "title": "Exact tenant and per-operation capabilities",
      "requirement": "Every product route, operation, bridge and worker SHALL derive current actor and scope from verified server context and enforce the owning capabilities. Role labels, GitHub membership and resource identifiers SHALL not widen access. Scope switches SHALL clear old-scope client state before rendering new data.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF01",
        "WF02",
        "WF11",
        "WF17"
      ],
      "task": "1.3",
      "sources": [
        "R09",
        "R11"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-039-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a permitted user has two Tenant assignments",
          "when": "they deliberately select a scope",
          "then": "each tab/request binds its selected authorized scope"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-039-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "caller input supplies another actor or Tenant grant",
          "when": "the operation validates",
          "then": "it rejects the forged authority and leaks no existence"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-040",
      "title": "Private Payload actor and service adapters",
      "requirement": "Human Payload operations SHALL pass the required exact actor/request/access/transaction context through the safe port, with access and editorial-lock bypass disabled. Registered service commands SHALL be narrower and independent. UI failure SHALL never reveal raw Payload Admin, accounts or APIs.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF01",
        "WF02",
        "WF10"
      ],
      "task": "1.3",
      "sources": [
        "R09",
        "E01"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-040-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "an authorized human content command",
          "when": "the adapter invokes Payload",
          "then": "scoped access and lock/revision rules remain enforced"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-040-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "the custom editor crashes or a direct provider URL is guessed",
          "when": "the request is handled",
          "then": "only a safe product state appears; no provider fallback grants access"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-041",
      "title": "Structural database integrity",
      "requirement": "Operational integration records SHALL use immutable trusted scope/attribution, same-scope keys, explicit legal states, appropriate uniqueness and noncascading retention. Exposed tables SHALL enforce both USING and WITH CHECK through tested grants/RLS. Private adapters SHALL not create parallel permission semantics.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF02",
        "WF11",
        "WF13",
        "WF14"
      ],
      "task": "1.3",
      "sources": [
        "R09",
        "E32"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-041-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a legitimate scoped relationship is written",
          "when": "database and owner checks run",
          "then": "only the valid same-scope relationship commits"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-041-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "an allowed row is updated into another Tenant or with forged ownership",
          "when": "restricted-role SQL/API executes",
          "then": "constraints/policy deny the transformation"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-042",
      "title": "Controlled integration disconnection and replacement",
      "requirement": "Disconnection/repository control changes SHALL fence new dependent source work and require re-verification to reconnect. Routine provider outage SHALL not be treated as deletion. Retained licensed compatible safe artifacts SHALL continue ordinary CMS operation under existing owner policies.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF16"
      ],
      "task": "4.1",
      "sources": [
        "E21",
        "R01"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-042-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "the ministry replaces its developer or source binding",
          "when": "new verified binding is prepared before switch",
          "then": "source history and ongoing editorial content are preserved"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-042-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a stale event arrives after disconnection",
          "when": "it requests build or activation",
          "then": "the old binding cannot regain authority"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-043",
      "title": "Explicit safe migrations",
      "requirement": "Catalog/schema/settings changes SHALL use an owner-approved no-write plan and fresh authorized commit to private successors where needed. Current content SHALL not be replaced by development snapshots. Mixed-version readers/writers, partial backfills and rollback/roll-forward SHALL have tested outcomes.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF15"
      ],
      "task": "6.2",
      "sources": [
        "R06",
        "R07",
        "E16",
        "E29"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-043-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a reviewed property migration is required",
          "when": "the approved plan commits against expected revisions",
          "then": "private compatible successors preserve original history"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-043-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "an editor changes a row after migration planning",
          "when": "commit rechecks inputs",
          "then": "that conflict is surfaced rather than overwriting the edit"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-044",
      "title": "Bounded resources and privacy-safe evidence",
      "requirement": "Intake, build, preview, editing and public rendering SHALL use a qualified numeric profile with fairness, backpressure and hard resource limits. Observability SHALL record safe identity/cause/outcome/timing without source, content, secrets or restricted facts in generic telemetry.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF13",
        "WF17"
      ],
      "task": "6.1",
      "sources": [
        "R05",
        "R10"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-044-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "several tenants submit valid bounded builds",
          "when": "capacity is exercised",
          "then": "fair queues and limits preserve unrelated safe service"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-044-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "an oversized source or runaway script appears",
          "when": "limits are reached",
          "then": "it is contained and diagnosed without leaking content or starving other tenants"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-045",
      "title": "Retained artifacts and preview expiry",
      "requirement": "Expiry SHALL revoke preview access and disposable compute without deleting acknowledged source/content or required receipts. Artifact/media removal SHALL require complete current use, rights and retention evidence; age alone SHALL not authorize purge of admitted versions.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF04",
        "WF14",
        "WF16",
        "WF17"
      ],
      "task": "6.1",
      "sources": [
        "R05",
        "R15"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-045-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a preview expires",
          "when": "cleanup executes",
          "then": "private access stops while required editorial/release state survives"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-045-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a supposedly unused artifact has incomplete use evidence",
          "when": "cleanup considers removal",
          "then": "purge is blocked rather than trusting a stale zero count"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-046",
      "title": "External coding-agent optionality",
      "requirement": "External agents MAY assist within the developer’s permitted project and provider arrangements. Their instructions SHALL not grant Asym authority, disclose restricted context or bypass independent admission. No hosted model account or agent session is required for this release.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF12",
        "WF18"
      ],
      "task": "4.3",
      "sources": [
        "R01",
        "R16"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-046-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a developer uses an external agent on synthetic fixtures",
          "when": "it submits source through Git",
          "then": "the normal tests and admission apply"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-046-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "generated code requests publication or operational secrets",
          "when": "the product boundary evaluates it",
          "then": "the request is denied regardless of agent instructions"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-047",
      "title": "Proven staff and developer handoff",
      "requirement": "Release acceptance SHALL demonstrate that staff can perform the agreed visual/content tasks after custom source changes and that a replacement developer can operate the supported project. Instructions SHALL identify maintenance, rights, safe previews, compatibility and source/config/content export limits.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF18"
      ],
      "task": "6.3",
      "sources": [
        "R01"
      ],
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "id": "HW-047-A",
          "name": "Expected journey",
          "given": "a nontechnical staff participant receives the site",
          "when": "they create a Page and update content after a custom redesign",
          "then": "the declared tasks succeed without code or developer intervention"
        },
        {
          "id": "HW-047-B",
          "name": "Adverse or boundary journey",
          "given": "a new developer has only the authorized project and docs",
          "when": "they set it up",
          "then": "no internal Core source or hidden privileged credential is required"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HW-048",
      "title": "Independent complete release evidence",
      "requirement": "Acceptance SHALL include owner-level contract tests, real database/authorization/concurrency, actual pinned editor adapter, real browser/SSR/preview, source/build security, migration, accessibility and production-shaped capacity tests. Structural document tests SHALL not be reported as implementation or provider proof.",
      "workflows": [
        "WF01",
        "WF02",
        "WF03",
        "WF04",
        "WF05",
        "WF06",
        "WF07",
        "WF08",
        "WF09",
        "WF10",
        "WF11",
        "WF12",
        "WF13",
        "WF14",
        "WF15",
        "WF16",
        "WF17",
        "WF18"
      ],
      "task": "6.4",
      "sources": [

[
  {

    "title": "Create a visual-first Site and first Page",
    "actor": "Authorized Site administrator, then content editor",

    "steps": [
      "Use the existing Site setup flow. Choose an exact locale and a qualified design; do not create domains, enable Giving or publish as hidden effects of choosing a template.",

      "Open the Asym editor, acquire the exact Page Editorial lease and show the private draft. A fresh copied Page gets fresh component instance IDs.",

<a id="research-refresh"></a>

## Part VII — Dated research, source provenance, and verification

### Research scope and status

**Review date: September 16, 2026.** The current task rechecked selected repository boundaries and official technical/competitor documentation for the two Studios. It did not audit every repository file, re-certify all providers or jurisdictions, or establish that the planned product is implemented. The preserved roadmap and source packages contain earlier dated evidence; retaining it here is not a claim that every historical statement was freshly verified.

The connected GitHub branch lookup returned `develop` at `7abd2c11ffd4ed70c6775c4fd6f51c996e4350dd`, matching the supplied Studio research baseline. The rechecked merged orchestration specification preserves product-owned business truth, shared tenant-scoped execution, identifier-only envelopes, and the dispatch/claim boundary. The principal-foundation ticket supplies the required NHI live-owner ceiling; it is a ticketed contract, not runtime proof. [NR-CORE-01–NR-CORE-04]

Original package validation reports remain in their source chapters. Fresh local rerun results are separated below. No Core application build, repository-pinned OpenSpec command, database migration, Postgres/Payload transaction test, browser product test, provider operation, repository write, GitHub issue edit, or deployment was performed by this compilation.

### Current official findings and their limited implications

| Reference | Verified documentation finding | Consequence for the existing design |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [NR-01](#nr-01) | Inngest documents 24-hour event/function deduplication windows and exceptions for selected features | Keep permanent domain-effect identity and original-request reconciliation; do not claim provider dedupe covers long-lived processes |
| [NR-02](#nr-02) | `waitForEvent` has listener-registration timing constraints; losing waits in parallel coordination require care | Retain source-backed durable waits, post-registration recheck, and reconciliation rather than relying on one listener |
| [NR-03](#nr-03) | Inngest rate limiting skips excess function starts; batching has explicit feature incompatibilities and first-event custom-concurrency-key behavior | Protect accepted work through durable admission and qualified flow control; test any batching strategy at tenant boundaries |
| [NR-04](#nr-04) | Puck distinguishes slot-field restrictions from render-time restrictions; outline dragging does not honor the latter | Test grammar enforcement in outline as well as canvas, non-drag commands, and server saves |
| [NR-05](#nr-05) | Puck's viewport uses a same-origin iframe | Do not confuse viewport/style isolation with Asym's whole-composer security boundary |
| [NR-06](#nr-06) | Payload threads transactions through request context and warns about unawaited transactional calls | Prove the actual single physical transaction and exact acknowledgment under the chosen cohort; separate HTTP calls are not automatically atomic |
| [NR-07](#nr-07) | React Flow documents keyboard, focus, and ARIA support | Retain those primitives while testing the complete custom authoring and participant experience |
| [NR-08](#nr-08) | SiteStacker's dated task-copy guide requires updating role bindings in tasks, forms, and related triggers | Make copied/imported Asym definitions visibly unresolved until every binding is validated; preserve convenient reuse without silent broken ownership |
| [NR-09](#nr-09) | Webflow documents external React code components with editable props, CMS bindings, and slots, and cautions against competing sources of truth | Reinforces the developer-to-staff handoff outcome; it does not justify importing arbitrary code into the privileged shell or claiming automatic round-tripping of all React |
| [NR-10](#nr-10) | GitHub may fall back to raw text when a rich preview is too large or complex; single-file diff limits are smaller than this full compilation | Keep this requested complete reading copy; use the companion navigable parts and original source files for practical repository review without deleting information |

These are specific documentation observations, not an independent hands-on test of competing products. SiteStacker's task-copy article is dated September 19, 2023; Webflow's code-component article is updated April 30, 2026. Neither date proves the behavior of every deployed customer installation.

### Source provenance and preservation policy

The source roadmap is `Asym_Program_Roadmap_Complete.docx`, with 45 phases and 113 rendered pages in the supplied document. Its substantive paragraph and table-cell text is preserved in Part I. Markdown headings, lists, emphasis, hyperlinks, and anchors replace Word presentation. The phase index's Page column retains the original Word page reference; Markdown navigation uses links rather than pagination.

The detailed Workflow Studio reading copy is the original `FULL-SPECIFICATION.md` from `workflow-studio-specification.zip`; it was verified byte-identical to the attached `workflow-studio-full-specification(1).md`. The hybrid Web Studio reading copy is `MASTER.md` from `Asym_Web_Studio_Specification_Package.zip`; it was verified byte-identical to the attached `MASTER(1).md`.

All source prose, requirements, scenarios, backlog entries, exclusions, evidence, and original validation reports in those reading copies are retained. Source heading levels, labelled-field paragraph spacing, and local links are adjusted for this single document. Explicitly labelled integration notes explain later roadmap allocation and known qualification issues; they do not masquerade as original source text. Standalone human documents duplicated by the reading copies were checked for coverage; the original archive preserves their exact files.

The recovered Workflow README and corrected hybrid-Web direction are included as additional source guidance. All 52 unique JSON, Python, JavaScript, and text reference artifacts selected from the original packages are embedded in Part VI as complete fenced source with byte counts and SHA-256 identities. The Web validation text is already included verbatim in its full specification and is not duplicated as a separate reference asset. The archives' manifest/hash files remain historical artifact records, not hashes of this combined document.

An example schema or blueprint is not executable deployment authorization. Recovering the original bytes makes the specification more complete; it does not make its symbolic source bindings real, remove an adoption gate, or certify its reference implementation.

#### Required evidence not established here

Core typecheck/lint/build and repository-pinned OpenSpec validation; actual Postgres/Payload transaction and RLS/grant behavior; action/fact/participant source certification; the installed Puck/React Flow browser integrations; accessibility of the built product; Inngest/provider behavior under deployment; SMS registration and delivery; enterprise IdP/SCIM interoperability; legal/carrier/residency qualification; production load and cost; approved runtime migrations; and live tenant acceptance remain implementation work.

The proposed `IG-AT-*` cases are additional integration qualification requirements. The source packages' `WS-AT-*`, recipe cases, and `HW-*-A/B` requirements remain specified implementation tests. Their presence in this file or success of local structural examples must never be reported as those product tests passing.

#### Practical use and repository adoption

Use the complete `.md` as the single portable reading copy. The companion package retains review-friendly parts, the original source archives, source hashes, the derived delivery map, and actual verification output. Those parts are navigation conveniences and contain no replacement summaries. GitHub or another viewer may limit rich previews of a file this large; raw text and a local Markdown editor retain the whole source.

Adoption into Core requires reconciling exact current source owners and already-ticketed work, recording any necessary later-phase successor decisions, using the repository's pinned tools, and attaching implementation evidence. Do not create duplicate tickets from raw proposal work-package IDs, delete earlier safety tests to activate a new lane, or archive an unimplemented OpenSpec change. This deliverable changes documents only, not the repository or its issues.
